notes.title: NEW UPDATE FOR H-Rescue
notes.content:
After a period of game launch, we have made a few updates:

- Add a choice to the end of the game. Now you can save Miraha by leaving a space for her to choose who will be saved.
- Fix some minor bugs in the game.
- Fix some errors related to achievements.
- Add loading screen.

Thank you for supporting us so far.
Happy gaming ♥♥♥

notes.title: H-Rescue is finally released and some note for users
notes.content:

notes.title: H-Rescue build, DLC ready and Trading Card awaiting
notes.content:
[h1][b]H-Rescue builds are ready to wait for Steam to check before release[/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058530/HRescue/
Hi friends,
Thanks for following and care about us all the time.
We trying our best to finish this game, and finaly, just 1 more step before release the game : [b]waiting for Steam team to check.[/b]
This is an important step, maybe it take several days depend on Steam before the game finaly release. 
We hope Steam will make this check fast with no issues.
Once again, we would like to thank all of you who have following us all this time.


[h1][b]H-Rescue : The True Of Magic (18+) DLC is ready[/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221340/HRescue__The_True_Of_Magic_18/
While waiting for Steam to check the build, we're done the DLC for the game.
This DLC will be available to get after the main game H-Rescue build get approve by Steam.
It will unlock full content of H-Rescue, include some minigame and images that not have in the main game. 
And ofcourse this DLC will be free.
We hope you guys will love this DLC.


[h1][b]And finaly, Trading cards, Badges, Emoji and Background Profile of H-Rescue are awaiting[/b][/h1]
Besides the Achievements you want, Trading Card is also something that many people want to have in a game on Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35824427/52b9f0a5f98c3fa98d81af15a60fbb69d6a2e0f0.png[/img]
Knowing that, we have completed the Trading Cards for the H-Rescue game. These Trading Cards will be available when the game is launched and sold for certain units that Steam requires.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35824427/f9d68220af37c4c558b1ba005c671907ac960e10.png[/img]
Although it's difficult to say in advance, we're really excited and want to let you know about it.
Hope you guys like them.
Thanks and have a nice day.
